### 0	distinct union
SELECT
`x__5` AS `x`,  
`x__5` AS `y`
FROM (
WITH `toks` AS 	(  
SELECT

1 AS `y__2`  )

`wrs8`.`x__1` AS `x__5`  
FROM `toks` AS `wrs8`

) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 3	having with union all
SELECT
`total_rows__7` AS `total_rows`
FROM (
WITH `toks` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `x__1`  )
,   
`toks2` AS 	(  
SELECT    
2 AS `x__4`  )
  
SELECT  
`total_rows__3` AS `total_rows__7`  
FROM (

zetasqlite_count(`wrs13`.`x__1`) AS `total_rows__3`    
FROM `toks` AS `wrs13`    
WHERE `wrs13`.`x__1` > 0
) AS `aggregate_scan_11`  
WHERE `total_rows__3` >= 0  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`total_rows__6` AS `total_rows__7`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_count(`wrs23`.`x__4`) AS `total_rows__6`    
FROM `toks2` AS `wrs23`    
WHERE `wrs23`.`x__4` > 0
) AS `aggregate_scan_21`  
WHERE `total_rows__6` >= 0
) AS `set_op_scan_3`;

### 36	recursive cte
SELECT
`iteration__7` AS `iteration`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `CTE_1` AS 	(  
SELECT    
`iteration__3` AS `iteration__4`    
FROM (
SELECT      
1 AS `iteration__3`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
1 AS `iteration__3`
) AS `set_op_scan_7`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
zetasqlite_add(`rrs17`.`iteration__4`, 1) AS `iteration__4`    
FROM `CTE_1` AS `rrs17`    
WHERE `rrs17`.`iteration__4` < 3  )
  
SELECT  
`iteration__7`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs19`.`iteration__4` AS `iteration__7`    
FROM `CTE_1` AS `wrs19`
) AS `with_ref_scan_19`  
ORDER BY `iteration__7` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 37	recursive cte 2
SELECT
`node__25` AS `node`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `GraphData` AS 	(  
SELECT

2 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL

1 AS `from_node__17`,      
3 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL

2 AS `from_node__17`,      
3 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
3 AS `from_node__17`,      
4 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
5 AS `from_node__17`,      
6 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
5 AS `from_node__17`,      
7 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
6 AS `from_node__17`,      
8 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
7 AS `from_node__17`,      
8 AS `to_node__18`  )
,   
`R` AS 	(  
SELECT    
5 AS `node__20`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
`with_ref_scan_39`.`to_node__18` AS `node__20`    
FROM `R` AS `recursive_ref_scan_38` INNER JOIN `GraphData` AS `with_ref_scan_39` ON `recursive_ref_scan_38`.`node__20` = `with_ref_scan_39`.`from_node__17`  )
  
SELECT  
`node__25`  
FROM (

`wrs42`.`node__20` AS `node__25`    
FROM `R` AS `wrs42`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs42`.`node__20`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_41`  
ORDER BY `node__25` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 42	recursive cte 7

`wrs52`.`type__68` AS `type__106`,      
`wrs52`.`upline_parent__69` AS `upline_parent__107`,      
`wrs52`.`pos__70` AS `pos__108`,      
`wrs52`.`iteration__71` AS `iteration__109`,      
`wrs52`.`distance_meters__72` AS `distance_meters__110`    
FROM `CTE_3` AS `wrs52`    
WHERE zetasqlite_greater(`wrs52`.`iteration__71`, zetasqlite_multiply(500, 2))
) AS `set_op_scan_41` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__111`,      
`type` AS `type__112`,      
`length_m` AS `length_m__113`,      
`upline_parent` AS `upline_parent__114`,      
`upline_feeder` AS `upline_feeder__115`    
FROM `grid_interior_resources` AS `b`
) AS `table_scan_53` ON `upline_parent__107` = `id__111`
) AS `with_scan_3`;
SELECT
`id__1` AS `id`,  
`type__2` AS `type`,  
`upline_resource_id__3` AS `upline_resource_id`,  
`upline_resource_type__4` AS `upline_resource_type`,  
`upline_resource_hops__5` AS `upline_resource_hops`,  
`upline_resource_distance__6` AS `upline_resource_distance`
FROM (
SELECT  
`id__1`,    
`type__2`,    
`upline_resource_id__3`,    
`upline_resource_type__4`,    
`upline_resource_hops__5`,    
`upline_resource_distance__6`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`type` AS `type__2`,      
`upline_resource_id` AS `upline_resource_id__3`,      
`upline_resource_type` AS `upline_resource_type__4`,      
`upline_resource_hops` AS `upline_resource_hops__5`,      
`upline_resource_distance` AS `upline_resource_distance__6`    
FROM `ancestry`
) AS `table_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `id__1` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC, `upline_resource_hops__5` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `grid_interior_resources`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `ancestry`;

### 44	recursive cte integration 2
CREATE TABLE `numbers` (`num` INT) ;
INSERT INTO `numbers`
 (`num`) 
 SELECT
`num__6` AS `num`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `seq` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `num__3`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
zetasqlite_add(`rrs12`.`num__3`, 1) AS `num__3`    
FROM `seq` AS `rrs12`    
WHERE `rrs12`.`num__3` < 5  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs14`.`num__3` AS `num__6`  
FROM `seq` AS `wrs14`
) AS `with_scan_3`;
SELECT
`num`
FROM `numbers`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `numbers`;

### 110	any_value with window

`fruit__1` AS `fruit`,  
`$analytic1__3` AS `$col2`
FROM (
SELECT  
`fruit__1`,    
zetasqlite_window_any_value(`fruit__1`) OVER (ORDER BY `$orderbycol1__4` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `$analytic1__3`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`$array_6`.`value` AS `fruit__1`,      
zetasqlite_length(`$array_6`.`value`) AS `$orderbycol1__4`    
FROM json_each(zetasqlite_decode_array("DgMEBWFwcGxlBAZiYW5hbmEEBHBlYXI=")) AS `$array_6`
) AS `project_scan_5`  
ORDER BY `$orderbycol1__4` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_4`;

### 111	any_value with having max
SELECT
`fruit__18` AS `fruit`,  
`max_sales__17` AS `max_sales`
FROM (
WITH `Store` AS 	(  
SELECT    
20 AS `sold__13`,      
"BAZhcHBsZXM=" AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__13`,      
"BAZhcHBsZXM=" AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
40 AS `sold__13`,      
"BAVwZWFycw==" AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__13`,      
"BAdvcmFuZ2Vz" AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
30 AS `sold__13`,      
"BAdiYW5hbmFz" AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__13`,      
"BAdiYW5hbmFz" AS `fruit__14`  )
  
SELECT  
`fruit__18`,    
`max_sales__17`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs26`.`fruit__14` AS `fruit__18`,      
zetasqlite_any_value(`wrs26`.`sold__13`, zetasqlite_having_max(`wrs26`.`sold__13`)) AS `max_sales__17`    
FROM `Store` AS `wrs26`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs26`.`fruit__14`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_25`

### 191	hll_count.merge

`distinct_customers_with_open_invoice__4` AS `distinct_customers_with_open_invoice`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_hll_count_merge(`hll_sketch__2`) AS `distinct_customers_with_open_invoice__4`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 0) AS `country__3`,      
zetasqlite_hll_count_init(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 1)) AS `hll_sketch__2`    
FROM json_each(zetasqlite_decode_array("")) AS `$array_7`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 0))
) AS `aggregate_scan_6`
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`;

) AS `aggregate_scan_4`;

### 193	hll_count.extract
SELECT
`country__3` AS `country`,  
`distinct_customers_with_open_invoice__4` AS `distinct_customers_with_open_invoice`
FROM (
SELECT  
`country__3`,    
zetasqlite_hll_count_extract(`hll_sketch__2`) AS `distinct_customers_with_open_invoice__4`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0) AS `country__3`,      
zetasqlite_hll_count_init(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 1)) AS `hll_sketch__2`    
FROM json_each(zetasqlite_decode_array("")) AS `$array_6`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0))
) AS `aggregate_scan_5`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### 195	window total
WITH `Produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
"BARrYWxl" AS `item__19`,    
23 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAl2ZWdldGFibGU=" AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BAZiYW5hbmE=" AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAVmcnVpdA==" AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BAdjYWJiYWdl" AS `item__19`,    
9 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAl2ZWdldGFibGU=" AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BAVhcHBsZQ==" AS `item__19`,    
8 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAVmcnVpdA==" AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BARsZWVr" AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAl2ZWdldGFibGU=" AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BAdsZXR0dWNl" AS `item__19`,    
10 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAl2ZWdldGFibGU=" AS `category__21`)

SELECT
`item__22` AS `item`,  
`purchases__23` AS `purchases`,  
`category__24` AS `category`,  
`total_purchases__26` AS `total_purchases`
FROM (
SELECT  
`item__22`,    
`purchases__23`,    
`category__24`,    
zetasqlite_window_sum(`purchases__23`) OVER (ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `total_purchases__26`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs26`.`item__19` AS `item__22`,      
`wrs26`.`purchases__20` AS `purchases__23`,      
`wrs26`.`category__21` AS `category__24`    
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs26`
) AS `with_ref_scan_26`
) AS `analytic_scan_25`;

### 205	nth_value

WITH `finishers` AS 	(

SELECT

### 209	window order by

UNION ALL  
SELECT

"BAFi" AS `letter__10`  
UNION ALL

"BAFj" AS `letter__10`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"CQoyMDI0LTAzLTAx" AS `dt__9`,    
"BAFh" AS `letter__10`)

SELECT

`letter__12` AS `letter`,  
`rn__14` AS `rn`
FROM (
SELECT  
`dt__11`,    
`letter__12`,

FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs20`.`dt__9` AS `dt__11`,      
`wrs20`.`letter__10` AS `letter__12`    
FROM `toks` AS `wrs20`
) AS `with_ref_scan_20`  
ORDER BY `dt__11` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC, `letter__12` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_19`;

`kind__11`,    
`purchases__12`  
FROM (

ORDER BY `item__10` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC)

FROM (

`purchases__15`,    
zetasqlite_window_lead(`item__13`) OVER (PARTITION BY `kind__14` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ORDER BY `item__13` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `next_in_kind__18`,    
zetasqlite_window_lag(`item__13`) OVER (ORDER BY `purchases__15` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `next_best_seller__19`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs18`.`item__10` AS `item__13`,      
`wrs18`.`kind__11` AS `kind__14`,      
`wrs18`.`purchases__12` AS `purchases__15`    
FROM `inventory` AS `wrs18`
) AS `with_ref_scan_18`  
ORDER BY `kind__14` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC, `item__13` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC, `purchases__15` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_17`;

FROM `segments` AS `wrs14`

ORDER BY `created_at__7` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC, `rank__8` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_13`;

### 283	array length comparison
SELECT
`idx__10` AS `idx`,  
`col1__11` AS `col1`,  
`arr_col__12` AS `arr_col`
FROM (
SELECT  
1 AS `idx__10`,    
1 AS `col1__11`,    
"DgMBAQAAAAAAAAABAgAAAAAAAAABAwAAAAAAAAA=" AS `arr_col__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
2 AS `idx__10`,    
2 AS `col1__11`,    
"DgMBAQAAAAAAAAABAgAAAAAAAAABAwAAAAAAAAA=" AS `arr_col__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
3 AS `idx__10`,    
3 AS `col1__11`,    
"DgQBAQAAAAAAAAABAgAAAAAAAAABAwAAAAAAAAABBAAAAAAAAAA=" AS `arr_col__12`
) AS `set_op_scan_6` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT  
1 AS `idx__22`,    
1 AS `col1__23`,    
"DgMBAQAAAAAAAAABAgAAAAAAAAABAwAAAAAAAAA=" AS `arr_col__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
3 AS `idx__22`,    
3 AS `col1__23`,    
"DgMBAQAAAAAAAAABAgAAAAAAAAABAwAAAAAAAAA=" AS `arr_col__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
4 AS `idx__22`,    
4 AS `col1__23`,    
"DgMBAQAAAAAAAAABAgAAAAAAAAABAwAAAAAAAAA=" AS `arr_col__24`
) AS `set_op_scan_16` ON `idx__10` = `idx__22`
WHERE zetasqlite_not_equal(zetasqlite_array_length(`arr_col__12`), zetasqlite_array_length(`arr_col__24`));

### 311	null array scan
SELECT
`id__7` AS `id`,  
`write_mode__12` AS `write_mode`,  
`read_mode__13` AS `read_mode`
FROM (
WITH `file` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `file_id__5`,      
"DgIEAXIEAXc=" AS `modes__6`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
2 AS `file_id__5`,      
"DgEEAXc=" AS `modes__6`  )
  
SELECT  
`id__7`,    
zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null((SELECT    
`$array_18`.`value` AS `mode__10`    
FROM json_each(zetasqlite_decode_array(`modes__9`)) AS `$array_18`    
WHERE `$array_18`.`value` = "BAF3"))) AS `write_mode__12`,    
zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null((SELECT    
`$array_21`.`value` AS `mode__11`    
FROM json_each(zetasqlite_decode_array(`modes__9`)) AS `$array_21`    
WHERE `$array_21`.`value` = "BAFy"))) AS `read_mode__13`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`$array_14`.`value` AS `id__7`    
FROM json_each(zetasqlite_decode_array("DgMBAQAAAAAAAAABAgAAAAAAAAABAwAAAAAAAAA=")) AS `$array_14`
) AS `array_scan_14` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`wrs15`.`file_id__5` AS `file_id__8`,      
`wrs15`.`modes__6` AS `modes__9`    
FROM `file` AS `wrs15`
) AS `with_ref_scan_15` ON `file_id__8` = `id__7`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 314	group by
WITH `Sales` AS 	(
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
8.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
4.56 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
2 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
1.0 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
4.25 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
0.99 AS `price__24`)

SELECT
`day__29` AS `day`,  
`total__28` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`wrs29`.`day__23` AS `day__29`,    
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`  
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`  
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`day__23`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_28`;

### 315	group by rollup with one column
WITH `Sales` AS 	(
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
8.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
4.56 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
2 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
1.0 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
4.25 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
0.99 AS `price__24`)

SELECT
`day__29` AS `day`,  
`total__28` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`day__29`,    
`total__28`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs29`.`day__23` AS `day__29`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`    
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`day__23`)    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
NULL AS `day`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`    
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`    
ORDER BY `wrs29`.`day__23` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `set_op_scan_inner`
) AS `aggregate_scan_28`;

### 316	group by rollup with two columns
SELECT
`sku__29` AS `sku`,  
`day__30` AS `day`,  
`total__28` AS `total`
FROM (
WITH `Sales` AS 	(  
SELECT    
123 AS `sku__22`,      
1 AS `day__23`,      
9.99 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
123 AS `sku__22`,      
1 AS `day__23`,      
8.99 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
456 AS `sku__22`,      
1 AS `day__23`,      
4.56 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
123 AS `sku__22`,      
2 AS `day__23`,      
9.99 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
789 AS `sku__22`,      
3 AS `day__23`,      
1.0 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
456 AS `sku__22`,      
3 AS `day__23`,      
4.25 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
789 AS `sku__22`,      
3 AS `day__23`,      
0.99 AS `price__24`  )
  
SELECT  
`sku__29`,    
`day__30`,    
`total__28`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`sku__29`,      
`day__30`,      
`total__28`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`wrs29`.`sku__22` AS `sku__29`,        
`wrs29`.`day__23` AS `day__30`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`      
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`sku__22`), zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`day__23`)      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
`wrs29`.`sku__22` AS `sku__29`,        
NULL AS `day`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`      
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`sku__22`)      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
NULL AS `sku`,        
NULL AS `day`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`      
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`      
ORDER BY `wrs29`.`sku__22` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC, `wrs29`.`day__23` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `set_op_scan_inner`
) AS `aggregate_scan_28`  
ORDER BY `sku__29` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC, `day__30` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 317	group by having

456 AS `sku__22`,

4.56 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT

2 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT

2 AS `day__23`,    
1.0 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
4.25 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
0.99 AS `price__24`)

SELECT
`day__29` AS `day`,  
`total__28` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`wrs30`.`day__23` AS `day__29`,    
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs30`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`,    
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs30`.`price__24`) AS `$agg2__30`  
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs30`  
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs30`.`day__23`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_29`
WHERE `$agg2__30` > 10.0;

UNION ALL

false AS `y__8`
) AS `set_op_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `x__7` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### 326	qualify
WITH `Produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
"BARrYWxl" AS `item__19`,    
23 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAl2ZWdldGFibGU=" AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BAZiYW5hbmE=" AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAVmcnVpdA==" AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BAdjYWJiYWdl" AS `item__19`,    
9 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAl2ZWdldGFibGU=" AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BAVhcHBsZQ==" AS `item__19`,    
8 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAVmcnVpdA==" AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BARsZWVr" AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAl2ZWdldGFibGU=" AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BAdsZXR0dWNl" AS `item__19`,    
10 AS `purchases__20`,    
"BAl2ZWdldGFibGU=" AS `category__21`)

SELECT
`item__22` AS `item`,  
`rank__26` AS `rank`
FROM (
SELECT  
`item__22`,    
`purchases__23`,    
`category__24`,    
zetasqlite_window_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY `category__24` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ORDER BY `purchases__23` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate DESC GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES) AS `rank__26`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs28`.`item__19` AS `item__22`,      
`wrs28`.`purchases__20` AS `purchases__23`,      
`wrs28`.`category__21` AS `category__24`    
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs28`    
WHERE `wrs28`.`category__21` = "BAl2ZWdldGFibGU="
) AS `filter_scan_27`  
ORDER BY `category__24` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC, `purchases__23` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate DESC
) AS `analytic_scan_26`
WHERE `rank__26` <= 3;

### 327	qualify without group by / where / having
WITH `toks` AS 	(
SELECT  
1 AS `x__3`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
2 AS `x__3`)

SELECT
`x__4` AS `x`
FROM (
SELECT  
`x__4`,    
zetasqlite_window_max(`x__4`) OVER (PARTITION BY `x__4` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `$analytic1__6`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs15`.`x__3` AS `x__4`    
FROM `toks` AS `wrs15`
) AS `with_ref_scan_15`  
ORDER BY `x__4` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_14`
WHERE `$analytic1__6` > 1;

### 328	qualify group
WITH `produce` AS 	(
SELECT

23 AS `purchases__2`)

`$agg1__5` AS `$col2`
FROM (
SELECT  
`item__6`,    
`$agg1__5`,    
zetasqlite_window_row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY `item__6` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ORDER BY `item__6` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `$analytic1__7`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs11`.`item__1` AS `item__6`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs11`.`purchases__2`) AS `$agg1__5`    
FROM `produce` AS `wrs11`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs11`.`item__1`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_10`  
ORDER BY `item__6` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC, `item__6` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_9`
WHERE `$analytic1__7` = 1;

### 337	farm_fingerprint
SELECT
`x__13` AS `x`,  
`y__14` AS `y`,  
`z__15` AS `z`,  
`$col2__16` AS `$col2`
FROM (
WITH `example` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `x__10`,      
"BANmb28=" AS `y__11`,      
true AS `z__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
2 AS `x__10`,      
"BAVhcHBsZQ==" AS `y__11`,      
false AS `z__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
3 AS `x__10`,      
"BAA=" AS `y__11`,      
true AS `z__12`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs16`.`x__10` AS `x__13`,    
`wrs16`.`y__11` AS `y__14`,    
`wrs16`.`z__12` AS `z__15`,    
zetasqlite_farm_fingerprint(zetasqlite_concat(zetasqlite_cast(`wrs16`.`x__10`, "BEt7Im5hbWUiOiIiLCJraW5kIjoyLCJzaWduYXR1cmVLaW5kIjowLCJlbGVtZW50VHlwZSI6bnVsbCwiZmllbGRUeXBlcyI6bnVsbH0=", "BEt7Im5hbWUiOiIiLCJraW5kIjo4LCJzaWduYXR1cmVLaW5kIjowLCJlbGVtZW50VHlwZSI6bnVsbCwiZmllbGRUeXBlcyI6bnVsbH0=", false), `wrs16`.`y__11`, zetasqlite_cast(`wrs16`.`z__12`, "BEt7Im5hbWUiOiIiLCJraW5kIjo1LCJzaWduYXR1cmVLaW5kIjowLCJlbGVtZW50VHlwZSI6bnVsbCwiZmllbGRUeXBlcyI6bnVsbH0=", "BEt7Im5hbWUiOiIiLCJraW5kIjo4LCJzaWduYXR1cmVLaW5kIjowLCJlbGVtZW50VHlwZSI6bnVsbCwiZmllbGRUeXBlcyI6bnVsbH0=", false))) AS `$col2__16`  
FROM `example` AS `wrs16`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 360	contains_substr for table all rows
WITH `Recipes` AS 	(
SELECT  
"BBJCbHVlYmVycnkgcGFuY2FrZXM=" AS `Breakfast__16`,    
"BBJFZ2cgc2FsYWQgc2FuZHdpY2g=" AS `Lunch__17`,    
"BBBQb3RhdG8gZHVtcGxpbmdz" AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BA9Qb3RhdG8gcGFuY2FrZXM=" AS `Breakfast__16`,    
"BBdUb2FzdGVkIGNoZWVzZSBzYW5kd2ljaA==" AS `Lunch__17`,

UNION ALL  
SELECT

"BAxUb21hdG8gcGFzdGE=" AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BA1Bdm9jYWRvIHRvYXN0" AS `Breakfast__16`,    
"BAtUb21hdG8gc291cA==" AS `Lunch__17`,    
"BBBCbHVlYmVycnkgc2FsbW9u" AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BBBDb3JuZWQgYmVlZiBoYXNo" AS `Breakfast__16`,    
"BBJMZW50aWwgcG90YXRvIHNvdXA=" AS `Lunch__17`,    
"BApHbGF6ZWQgaGFt" AS `Dinner__18`)

SELECT
`wrs23`.`Breakfast__16` AS `Breakfast`,

### 438	translate
SELECT

`$col4__25` AS `$col4`
FROM (
WITH `example` AS 	(  
SELECT    
"BBBUaGlzIGlzIGEgY29va2ll" AS `expression__16`,      
"BANzY28=" AS `source_characters__17`,      
"BAN6a3U=" AS `target_characters__18`

"BAlBIGNvYXN0ZXI=" AS `expression__16`,      
"BAJjbw==" AS `source_characters__17`,      
"BAFr" AS `target_characters__18`    
UNION ALL

"BAFr" AS `target_characters__18`    
UNION ALL

null AS `source_characters__17`,      
"BAFr" AS `target_characters__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
"BAlBIGNvYXN0ZXI=" AS `expression__16`,      
"BAJjbw==" AS `source_characters__17`,      
null AS `target_characters__18`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs25`.`expression__16` AS `expression__22`,    
`wrs25`.`source_characters__17` AS `source_characters__23`,    
`wrs25`.`target_characters__18` AS `target_characters__24`,    
zetasqlite_translate(`wrs25`.`expression__16`, `wrs25`.`source_characters__17`, `wrs25`.`target_characters__18`) AS `$col4__25`  
FROM `example` AS `wrs25`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 454	PIVOT
WITH `produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
"BARLYWxl" AS `product__37`,    
51 AS `sales__38`,    
"BAJRMQ==" AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL

"BAJRMg==" AS `quarter__39`,

UNION ALL

2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BARLYWxl" AS `product__37`,    
3 AS `sales__38`,    
"BAJRNA==" AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BARLYWxl" AS `product__37`,    
70 AS `sales__38`,    
"BAJRMQ==" AS `quarter__39`,    
2021 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BARLYWxl" AS `product__37`,    
85 AS `sales__38`,    
"BAJRMg==" AS `quarter__39`,    
2021 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BAVBcHBsZQ==" AS `product__37`,    
77 AS `sales__38`,    
"BAJRMQ==" AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BAVBcHBsZQ==" AS `product__37`,    
0 AS `sales__38`,    
"BAJRMg==" AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
"BAVBcHBsZQ==" AS `product__37`,    
1 AS `sales__38`,    
"BAJRMQ==" AS `quarter__39`,    
2021 AS `year__40`)

SELECT
`product__46` AS `product`,  
`year__47` AS `year`,  
`Q1__48` AS `Q1`,  
`Q2__49` AS `Q2`,  
`Q3__50` AS `Q3`,  
`Q4__51` AS `Q4`
FROM (
SELECT  
`wrs36`.`product__37` AS `product__46`,    
`wrs36`.`year__40` AS `year__47`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, "BAJRMQ==") THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__57`)) AS `Q1__48`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, "BAJRMg==") THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__61`)) AS `Q2__49`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, "BAJRMw==") THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__65`)) AS `Q3__50`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, "BAJRNA==") THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__69`)) AS `Q4__51`  
FROM `produce` AS `wrs36`  
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs36`.`product__37`), zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs36`.`year__40`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_34`;

### 455	UNPIVOT
WITH `Produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
"BARLYWxl" AS `product__11`,    
51 AS `Q1__12`,    
23 AS `Q2__13`,    
45 AS `Q3__14`,    
3 AS `Q4__15`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT

SELECT
`product__23` AS `product`,  
`sales__21` AS `sales`,  
`quarter__22` AS `quarter`
FROM (
SELECT  
`with_ref_scan_16`.`product__16` AS `product__23`,    
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_15`.`value`, 0) AS `sales__21`,    
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_15`.`value`, 1) AS `quarter__22`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs16`.`product__11` AS `product__16`,      
`wrs16`.`Q1__12` AS `Q1__17`,      
`wrs16`.`Q2__13` AS `Q2__18`,      
`wrs16`.`Q3__14` AS `Q3__19`,      
`wrs16`.`Q4__15` AS `Q4__20`    
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs16`
) AS `with_ref_scan_16` CROSS JOIN json_each(zetasqlite_decode_array(zetasqlite_make_array(zetasqlite_make_struct("BAVzYWxlcw==", `Q1__17`, "BAdxdWFydGVy", "BAJRMQ=="), zetasqlite_make_struct("BAVzYWxlcw==", `Q2__18`, "BAdxdWFydGVy", "BAJRMg=="), zetasqlite_make_struct("BAVzYWxlcw==", `Q3__19`, "BAdxdWFydGVy", "BAJRMw=="), zetasqlite_make_struct("BAVzYWxlcw==", `Q4__20`, "BAdxdWFydGVy", "BAJRNA==")))) AS `$array_15`  
WHERE zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_15`.`value`, 0)))
) AS `project_scan_13`;

FROM (
SELECT    
"BANmb28=" AS `value__4`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
"BANiYXI=" AS `value__4`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
"BANiYXo=" AS `value__4`
) AS `set_op_scan_4`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### 630	replace

`wrs8`.`item_name__2` AS `item_name__5`,    
zetasqlite_divide(zetasqlite_cast(`wrs8`.`quantity__3`, "BEt7Im5hbWUiOiIiLCJraW5kIjoyLCJzaWduYXR1cmVLaW5kIjowLCJlbGVtZW50VHlwZSI6bnVsbCwiZmllbGRUeXBlcyI6bnVsbH0=", "BEt7Im5hbWUiOiIiLCJraW5kIjo3LCJzaWduYXR1cmVLaW5kIjowLCJlbGVtZW50VHlwZSI6bnVsbCwiZmllbGRUeXBlcyI6bnVsbH0=", false), 2.0) AS `quantity__7`  
FROM `orders` AS `wrs8`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 682	to_json
SELECT
`json_objects__12` AS `json_objects`
FROM (
WITH `CoordinatesTable` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `id__7`,      
"DgIBCgAAAAAAAAABFAAAAAAAAAA=" AS `coordinates__8`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
2 AS `id__7`,      
"DgIBHgAAAAAAAAABKAAAAAAAAAA=" AS `coordinates__8`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
3 AS `id__7`,      
"DgIBMgAAAAAAAAABPAAAAAAAAAA=" AS `coordinates__8`  )
  
SELECT  
zetasqlite_to_json(zetasqlite_make_struct("BAJpZA==", `wrs16`.`id__7`, "BAtjb29yZGluYXRlcw==", `wrs16`.`coordinates__8`), false) AS `json_objects__12`  
FROM `CoordinatesTable` AS `wrs16`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 683	to_json with struct
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_to_json(zetasqlite_make_struct("BAFh", "BANmb28=", "BAFi", zetasqlite_to_json("DwEBYwQDYmFy", false)), false) AS `$col1__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### 684	to_json_string
SELECT
`id__9` AS `id`,  
`coordinates__10` AS `coordinates`,  
`json_data__12` AS `json_data`
FROM (
WITH `CoordinatesTable` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `id__7`,      
"DgIBCgAAAAAAAAABFAAAAAAAAAA=" AS `coordinates__8`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
2 AS `id__7`,      
"DgIBHgAAAAAAAAABKAAAAAAAAAA=" AS `coordinates__8`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
3 AS `id__7`,      
"DgIBMgAAAAAAAAABPAAAAAAAAAA=" AS `coordinates__8`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs16`.`id__7` AS `id__9`,    
`wrs16`.`coordinates__8` AS `coordinates__10`,    
zetasqlite_to_json_string(zetasqlite_make_struct("BAJpZA==", `wrs16`.`id__7`, "BAtjb29yZGluYXRlcw==", `wrs16`.`coordinates__8`)) AS `json_data__12`  
FROM `CoordinatesTable` AS `wrs16`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 686	compare_arrays_with_json_null_only
SELECT
`result__6` AS `result`
FROM (
WITH `input_rows` AS 	(  
SELECT    
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0) AS `a__2`,      
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 1) AS `b__3`    
FROM json_each(zetasqlite_decode_array(zetasqlite_make_array(zetasqlite_make_struct("BAFh", null, "BAFi", "DgA=")))) AS `$array_6`  )
  
SELECT  
zetasqlite_to_json_string(`wrs8`.`a__2`) AS `result__6`  
FROM `input_rows` AS `wrs8`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 687	compare_arrays_with_json_mixed

`result__6` AS `result`
FROM (

### 721	limit offset test
CREATE TABLE `IconNames` AS SELECT
`FirstName__5` AS `FirstName`,  
`LastName__6` AS `LastName`
FROM (
SELECT  
"BAVLeWxpZQ==" AS `FirstName__5`,    
"BAdNaW5vZ3Vl" AS `LastName__6`  
UNION ALL

"BAVSb2J5bg==" AS `FirstName__5`,    
null AS `LastName__6`
) AS `set_op_scan_4`;
INSERT INTO `IconNames`
 (`FirstName`, `LastName`) 
VALUES 
("BAVCam9yaw==",null);
SELECT
`FirstName__1` AS `FirstName`,  
`LastName__2` AS `LastName`
FROM (
SELECT  
`FirstName__1`,    
`LastName__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`FirstName` AS `FirstName__1`,      
`LastName` AS `LastName__2`    
FROM `IconNames`
) AS `table_scan_5`  
ORDER BY `FirstName__1` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC  
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
) AS `limit_scan_3`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `IconNames`;

### 726	merge two tables with empty source
CREATE TABLE `target` (`id` INT,`name` TEXT) ;
CREATE TABLE `source` (`id` INT,`name` TEXT) ;
CREATE TABLE `zetasqlite_merged_table` AS SELECT DISTINCT
*
FROM (
SELECT  
`id__3` AS `merged_source_id`,    
`name__4` AS `merged_source_name`,    
`id__1` AS `merged_target_id`,    
`name__2` AS `merged_target_name`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__3`,      
`name` AS `name__4`    
FROM `source` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`name` AS `name__2`    
FROM `target` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` ON `id__1` = `id__3`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`id__3` AS `merged_source_id`,    
`name__4` AS `merged_source_name`,    
`id__1` AS `merged_target_id`,    
`name__2` AS `merged_target_name`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`name` AS `name__2`    
FROM `target` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__3`,      
`name` AS `name__4`    
FROM `source` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` ON `id__1` = `id__3`
) AS `merged_union`;
UPDATE `target` SET `id`= `merged_source_id`,`name`= `merged_source_name` FROM zetasqlite_merged_table WHERE `merged_source_id` = `id` AND `merged_target_id` = `id`;
INSERT INTO `target` (`id`,`name`) SELECT `id__3` AS `id`,`name__4` AS `name` FROM (
SELECT  
`id` AS `id__3`,    
`name` AS `name__4`  
FROM `source` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4`;
DROP TABLE zetasqlite_merged_table;
SELECT
`id`,  
`name`
FROM `target`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `target`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `source`;

### 735	with ref scan maps column aliases correctly
CREATE TABLE `events` (`ID` TEXT,`DT` TEXT) ;
WITH `events_cte` AS 	(
SELECT  
`ID` AS `ID__1`,    
zetasqlite_extract_date(zetasqlite_parse_datetime("BA4lbS8lZC8leSAlSDolTQ==", zetasqlite_nullif(`DT`, "BA4wOS8xNy8yNSAwMDowMA=="))) AS `event_date__3`  
FROM `events`)

SELECT
`wrs9`.`ID__1` AS `event_id`,  
`wrs9`.`event_date__3` AS `occurrence_date`
FROM `events_cte` AS `wrs9`
WHERE zetasqlite_equal(zetasqlite_extract(`wrs9`.`event_date__3`, "BARZRUFS"), 2025);
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `events`;

### 736	ProjectScan with order by column does not output ordered column
SELECT
`name__3` AS `name`,  
`cols__4` AS `cols`
FROM (
WITH `names` AS 	(  
SELECT    
"BANmb28=" AS `name__1`,      
"DgIEAXgEAXk=" AS `cols__2`  )
  
SELECT  
`name__3`,    
`cols__4`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs9`.`name__1` AS `name__3`,      
`wrs9`.`cols__2` AS `cols__4`,      
zetasqlite_safe_array_at_offset(`wrs9`.`cols__2`, 0) AS `$orderbycol2__5`    
FROM `names` AS `wrs9`
) AS `project_scan_8`  
ORDER BY `name__3` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC, `$orderbycol2__5` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 737	recursive cte with star expression

FROM (

"BAFh" AS `letter__2`  )
,   
`T1` AS 	(  
SELECT    
`wrs11`.`n__1` AS `n__5`,      
`wrs11`.`letter__2` AS `letter__6`    
FROM `T0` AS `wrs11`    
UNION ALL

zetasqlite_add(`rrs15`.`n__5`, 1) AS `n__5`,      
`rrs15`.`letter__6`    
FROM `T1` AS `rrs15`    
WHERE `rrs15`.`n__5` < 3  )
  
SELECT  
`n__10`,    
`letter__11`  
FROM (

`wrs17`.`n__5` AS `n__10`,      
`wrs17`.`letter__6` AS `letter__11`    
FROM `T1` AS `wrs17`

ORDER BY `n__10` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 742	group by struct values basic
SELECT
`person__6` AS `person`,  
`count__5` AS `count`
FROM (
SELECT  
`person__6`,    
`count__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`person__4` AS `person__6`,      
zetasqlite_count_star() AS `count__5`    
FROM (
SELECT      
"DwIEbmFtZQQFQWxpY2UDYWdlAR4AAAAAAAAA" AS `person__4`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DwIEbmFtZQQFQWxpY2UDYWdlAR4AAAAAAAAA" AS `person__4`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DwIEbmFtZQQDQm9iA2FnZQEZAAAAAAAAAA==" AS `person__4`
) AS `set_op_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`person__4`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `count__5` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate DESC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### 743	group by struct values with aggregation
SELECT
`person__12` AS `person`,  
`total__11` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`person__12`,    
`total__11`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`person__9` AS `person__12`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`amount__10`) AS `total__11`    
FROM (
SELECT      
"DwIEbmFtZQQFQWxpY2UEZGVwdAQFU2FsZXM=" AS `person__9`,        
100 AS `amount__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DwIEbmFtZQQFQWxpY2UEZGVwdAQFU2FsZXM=" AS `person__9`,        
200 AS `amount__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DwIEbmFtZQQDQm9iBGRlcHQEC0VuZ2luZWVyaW5n" AS `person__9`,        
150 AS `amount__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DwIEbmFtZQQDQm9iBGRlcHQEC0VuZ2luZWVyaW5n" AS `person__9`,        
250 AS `amount__10`
) AS `set_op_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`person__9`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `total__11` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate DESC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

SELECT    
`labels__9` AS `labels__12`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`value__10`) AS `total__11`    
FROM (
SELECT      
"DgIEAUEEAUI=" AS `labels__9`,        
10 AS `value__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DgIEAUEEAUI=" AS `labels__9`,        
20 AS `value__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DgIEAUMEAUQ=" AS `labels__9`,        
30 AS `value__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DgIEAUMEAUQ=" AS `labels__9`,        
40 AS `value__10`
) AS `set_op_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`labels__9`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `total__11` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate DESC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### 746	group by nested struct with arrays
SELECT
`data__6` AS `data`,  
`count__5` AS `count`
FROM (
SELECT  
`data__6`,    
`count__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`data__4` AS `data__6`,      
zetasqlite_count_star() AS `count__5`    
FROM (
SELECT      
"DwIEdGFncw4CBAR0YWcxBAR0YWcyB3VzZXJfaWQEBXVzZXIx" AS `data__4`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DwIEdGFncw4CBAR0YWcxBAR0YWcyB3VzZXJfaWQEBXVzZXIx" AS `data__4`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DwIEdGFncw4BBAR0YWczB3VzZXJfaWQEBXVzZXIy" AS `data__4`
) AS `set_op_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`data__4`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `count__5` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate DESC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### 747	group by array of structs
SELECT
`items__10` AS `items`,  
`sum_total__9` AS `sum_total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`items__10`,    
`sum_total__9`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`items__7` AS `items__10`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`total__8`) AS `sum_total__9`    
FROM (
SELECT      
"DgIPAgRuYW1lBAVpdGVtMQVwcmljZQEKAAAAAAAAAA8CBG5hbWUEBWl0ZW0yBXByaWNlARQAAAAAAAAA" AS `items__7`,        
100 AS `total__8`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DgIPAgRuYW1lBAVpdGVtMQVwcmljZQEKAAAAAAAAAA8CBG5hbWUEBWl0ZW0yBXByaWNlARQAAAAAAAAA" AS `items__7`,        
200 AS `total__8`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
"DgEPAgRuYW1lBAVpdGVtMwVwcmljZQEeAAAAAAAAAA==" AS `items__7`,        
150 AS `total__8`
) AS `set_op_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`items__7`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `sum_total__9` COLLATE zetasqlite_collate DESC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;
